featureFlags.title: Feature flags
featureFlags.description: Enable or disable experimental features for this user. Each change is recorded in the audit log. Enabling a flag also enables its prerequisites.
featureFlags.dormantNote: Not enable-able — relocated to the paper in Phase 7 (ADR-032).
featureFlags.disableDescription: {{flag}} has {{count}} active sub-flag(s) that depend on it: {{dependents}}. Disabling it disables them too. Disable all or cancel?

pastoral_fidelity_flow.description: Activates the reformed pastoral fidelity flow (six-step spine, three witnesses). Requires the user to have declared a confession.

pastoral_word_study.description: Replaces the embedded Greek tutor in Morphology with the Pastoral Word Study modal (Phase 1.5). Requires pastoral_fidelity_flow to also be on.

study_depth.label: Study Companion
study_depth.description: Study-depth badge + per-step orientation in the wizard (Phase 2.5). Requires pastoral fidelity flow.

fidelity_pass.label: Fidelity pass
fidelity_pass.description: Claim/source fidelity pass — second-pass LLM that scores every `[N]` marker in a generated sermon and surfaces a review panel in the editor (Phase 3, ADR-029). Requires pastoral_fidelity_flow.

contra_scan.label: Contra-scan
contra_scan.description: Pre-publish confrontation: surfaces library chunks that dissent from the sermon's central idea and requires the pastor to consider at least one before publishing (Phase 4, ADR-033, Acts 20:27). Requires pastoral_fidelity_flow.

conduccion_corazon.label: Heart conduction
conduccion_corazon.description: "Conduct the heart" button in the Master Study: guided C1–C5 conduction that elicits the affective application anchored to the text (formative conduction manifesto). Validated in prod — the heart exam is already deployed.

three_witnesses.label: Three witnesses
three_witnesses.description: Three-witnesses gate after the pastoral seed is complete: immediate context, canonical parallels and the pastor's own declared confession validate the central idea before drafting (Phase 2, ADR-011).

passage_profile.label: Passage profile (shadow)
passage_profile.description: Passage profile in SHADOW mode: the detector runs when the study starts and records what it would have said, without confronting or nudging. This is the MEASUREMENT flag — turn it on before any of its enforce flags (ADR-035).

passage_profile_enforce.label: Passage profile (enforce)
passage_profile_enforce.description: Applies the profile live: per-step nudges, misreading confrontation and the coverage collector at close. Only after the detector's precision has been adjudicated in shadow (ADR-035).

anchor_fidelity_enforce.label: Anchor fidelity (enforce)
anchor_fidelity_enforce.description: Drops the misreadings the detector proposes without a verifiable anchor (the cited verse does not exist). The curated floor of reviewed misreadings does NOT depend on this flag — it is always verified (ADR-036).

sermon_draft_shadow.label: Draft shadow
sermon_draft_shadow.description: Draft shadow: measures fabricated authority quotes, wrong verse citations and homiletical-approach compliance. Blocks nothing — it is the instrumentation every validator depends on (Redacción v2).

genre_override_enforce.label: Genre override (enforce)
genre_override_enforce.description: The system confronts the pastor about the genre of their pericope in step 2 instead of only measuring it in shadow. Measurement runs under passage profile; this flag turns on the confrontation (Redacción v2 §4.4).

step3_genre_help.label: Step 3 genre help
step3_genre_help.description: Genre-aware structural help in step 3: guidance and worked examples for the confirmed genre instead of the generic prompt. Formative scaffolding, not judgement (Redacción v2 §4.5).

socratic_drafting.description: ADR-037 — Socratic drafting by elements. The pastor decides which idea goes in each section (his own, or chosen/edited from a suggestion) and the prose is written afterwards. SPIKE: for now only the historical-context section, in the Drafting step.

voice_fingerprint.label: Preacher's voice
voice_fingerprint.description: The generated draft mirrors HOW the pastor writes, using excerpts from sermons he assembled in the workshop. Never copies their content, only their form. With no sermons of his own it does nothing and says nothing.
